stories.title: Andy Burnham says no to Wales taking control of policing, rail infrastructure and The Crown Estate
stories.summary: Prime Minister Andy Burnham has said no to Wales taking control of its own policing, railway infrastructure and The Crown Estate. stories.title: 109 affordable homes in Flint get final sign-off after legal agreement
stories.summary: Formal planning permission has been issued for 109 affordable homes at Oakenholt in Flint, after a legal agreement with the developer was completed. stories.title: Three arrests and 55 calls in 24 hours for south Flintshire police
stories.summary: Police officers in south Flintshire dealt with 55 calls for service in 24 hours, including six emergencies attended on blue lights, according to the local neighbourhood policing team. The figures were posted on Saturday morning, 21 November, by North Wales Police’s South Flintshire team on its Facebook page. Three people were arrested during the period.

stories.title: Senedd rejects Labour motion to shield Welsh graduates from student loan freeze
